events.quote_anchor: As he crossed the road, he glanced up, toward the camera mounted on a nearby stoplight. Held its gaze, and smiled.

events.quote_anchor: Victor slipped down the alley, approaching the metal door the chemist had used. The one he’d wedged ajar so he could come and go.

events.quote_anchor: But the last dose he’d taken had yet to wear off, so he settled for drawing the gun from his pocket.

events.quote_anchor: Well, then,” said Victor, leaning back against a set of cabinets. “I suggest you get to work.
